sentences.text: David Robert Joseph Beckham , -LRB- -LSB- ˈbɛkəm -RSB- born 2 May 1975 -RRB- is an English former professional footballer .	footballer	Association football

He announced his retirement in May 2013 after a 20-year career , during which he won 19 major trophies .

Known for his range of passing , crossing ability and bending free-kicks as a right winger , Beckham was runner up in the Ballon d'Or , twice runner-up for FIFA World Player of the Year and in 2004 he was named by Pelé in the FIFA 100 list of the world 's greatest living players .	crossing ability	Cross (football)	bending	Curl (football)	free-kicks	Direct free kick	right winger	Midfielder#Winger	Ballon d'Or	Ballon d'Or	FIFA World Player of the Year	FIFA World Player of the Year	Pelé	Pelé	FIFA 100	FIFA 100	2004	UEFA Euro 2004
